theorem_title: Theorem F: for z rational in u with |u|² algebraic, which conjugation hulls span(1, u, ū, z, z̄) carry a 2×3 configuration
formal_statement:
open Complex ComplexConjugate

namespace DiazModulus

open Polynomial in
theorem rational_conj_hull_two_by_three_configuration_iff (u z : ℂ) (hu : u ∉ Qbar)
    (hρ : IsAlgebraic ℚ (u * conj u)) (hz : z ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin Qbar ({u} : Set ℂ)) :
    (∃ (x : Fin 2 → ℂ) (y : Fin 3 → ℂ), LinearIndependent (↥Qbar) x ∧ LinearIndependent (↥Qbar) y ∧
        ∀ i j, x i * y j ∈ Submodule.span Qbar ({1, u, conj u, z, conj z} : Set ℂ)) ↔
      (Module.finrank (↥Qbar) (Submodule.span Qbar ({1, u, conj u, z, conj z} : Set ℂ)) = 4 ∧ ∃ a ∈ Qbar, a * conj a = u * conj u ∧
          z ∈ Submodule.span Qbar ({1, u, conj u, (u - a)⁻¹} : Set ℂ)) ∨
      (Module.finrank (↥Qbar) (Submodule.span Qbar ({1, u, conj u, z, conj z} : Set ℂ)) = 5 ∧
        ((∃ t : Fin 3 → ℂ, LinearIndependent (↥Qbar) t ∧ ∀ j, t j ∈ Submodule.span Qbar ({1, u, conj u, z, conj z} : Set ℂ) ∧ u * t j ∈ Submodule.span Qbar ({1, u, conj u, z, conj z} : Set ℂ)) ∨ (∃ P' Q' S₁ S₂ : (↥Qbar)[X], IsCoprime P' Q' ∧ max P'.natDegree Q'.natDegree = 2 ∧
        S₁.natDegree ≤ 2 ∧ S₂.natDegree ≤ 2 ∧
        Submodule.span Qbar ({1, u, conj u, z, conj z} : Set ℂ) = Submodule.span Qbar ({1, u, u⁻¹, aeval u Q' * aeval u S₁ / (u * aeval u P'),
          aeval u P' * aeval u S₂ / (u * aeval u Q')} : Set ℂ)) ∨
        (∃ P' Q' S₁ S₂ : (↥Qbar)[X], IsCoprime P' Q' ∧ max P'.natDegree Q'.natDegree = 2 ∧
        S₁.natDegree ≤ 2 ∧ S₂.natDegree ≤ 2 ∧
        Submodule.span Qbar ({1, u, conj u, z, conj z} : Set ℂ) = Submodule.span Qbar ({1, u, u⁻¹, aeval u Q' * aeval u S₁ / (u * aeval u P'),
          aeval u Q' * (aeval u Q' * aeval u S₁ + aeval u P' * aeval u S₂) / (u * aeval u P' ^ 2)} :
            Set ℂ)))) := by
  sorry

end DiazModulus
source: Not found in the sources read: the “only if” half, the classification. Theorem F asks the question of Theorem E of the mission's research note on polynomial and Laurent hulls (DiazModulus.laurent_conj_hull_two_by_three_configuration_iff, Laurent z) for every z rational in u, and builds on Theorem B (DiazModulus.circle_point_extension_two_by_three_configuration_iff, 10.6), which holds for every complex z. For Laurent z, agreement with Theorem E's classes was checked by exact computation, not proved. Its configurations give, at a candidate, exclusions that are substitutions in Roy's strong six exponentials theorem (D. Roy, Matrices whose coefficients are linear forms in logarithms, J. Number Theory 41 (1992), 22–47, Cor. 2). Special cases of the “if” half are printed: in dimension 4 the configuration is G. Diaz, Produits et quotients de combinaisons linéaires de logarithmes de nombres algébriques : conjectures et résultats partiels, J. Théor. Nombres Bordeaux 19 (2007), 373–391, Théorème 7(1) at v = 1/(u − a), with the exclusion in its Corollaire 5(4); for polynomials of degree 2 and 3 in u it is Théorème 7(1); Theorem E's class (Q) is a substitution in G. Diaz, Utilisation de la conjugaison complexe dans l'étude de la transcendance de valeurs de la fonction exponentielle usuelle, J. Théor. Nombres Bordeaux 16 (2004), 535–553, Théorème 2, and in Diaz 2007, Théorème 4(1). Uses DiazModulus.rational_space_two_by_three_configuration_iff, DiazModulus.rational_conj_hull_le_adjoin, DiazModulus.conj_hull_finrank_four_two_by_three_configuration_iff and DiazModulus.circle_point_config_card_le_four. R20 of the Diaz modulus mission. Formal proof: Diaz modulus mission, 23 October 2026 (C. Perassi).
